description: Original quantitative data re-rendered as Georgia Canvas graphics. No screenshot or previously encoded movie is an input.
animation: Measured positions are revealed. Connecting lines and aggregate marks animate as visual transitions, not additional observations or simulated trajectories.

clips.name: scaling
clips.semantics: Eight measured scaling markers; original SVG coordinates and fitted exponent. Both axes explicitly mark logarithmic scales where used.

clips.name: zero-shot
clips.semantics: Zero-shot fitness prediction: all 15 model means/SEM across 19 excluded assays. First-round selection on 13 single-mutant assays: Spearman, AUROC, AUPR and top-K hit fractions; mean/SEM. MULTI-evolve rank-fusion adaptation. Figure 2F axis ranges and broken baselines; no significance stars. Hits are at or above assay mean, not WT.

clips.name: structure-speed
clips.semantics: Mean inference time in five atom-count bins; log time axis, exact measured ratios.

clips.name: higher-order
clips.semantics: All 40 protein-phenotype-K comparisons, K=1/2/3; means, SEM and individual values.

clips.name: closed-loop
clips.semantics: Simulated multi-mutant evolution on 17 datasets; normalized best fitness with SEM, 5 rounds and 4 methods.

clips.name: sacb-activity
clips.semantics: Measured SacB cumulative top 10 per round, 90 assayed variants, 3 snapshots, WT=1.

clips.name: aldh-activity
clips.semantics: Measured ALDH cumulative top 10 per round, 150 assayed variants, 5 snapshots, WT=1.
